scripts.text:
[Soy]
Mimi, what should I do?
My heart is beating so fast. Ahhh~
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
米米，我該怎麼辦？
我的心跳得好快。啊嗚~

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
Why is you face so flushed? Ha ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
你的臉怎麼這麼紅？哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Soy]
Don't make fun of me Mimi~
I have dreamed of being at Dancer Kim's stage for a very long time!
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
別取笑我啦，米米~
我夢想著能登上舞娘 金的舞臺已經很久了！

scripts.text:
[Soy]
I might lose my senses if I really see her dancing like a beautiful angel sent from above.
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
如果真看到她像天使一樣從天而降翩翩起舞，我可能會失去理智。

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
Calm down, Soy.
You are going to faint even before the performance starts. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
冷靜點，索伊。
你還沒開始表演就要暈倒了。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
But I understand you.
Many people are looking forward to meeting the best Wanderer in the world.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
但我理解你。
很多人都很期待見到世界上最棒的浪姬舞者。

scripts.text: Dancer Kim?
scripts.translation: 舞娘 金？

scripts.text: Wanderer?
scripts.translation: 浪姬舞者？

scripts.text:
[Soy]
What? You don't know the famous Wanderer, Dancer Kim?
Oh my, oh my!!!
You seem to know the art of dancing but how come you don't know her?
Oh, no!
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
什麼？你不知道著名的浪姬舞者，舞娘 金？
天哪，天哪！！！
你似乎很懂舞蹈，怎麼會不知道她呢？
哎呀，不行！

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
A Wanderer is a free-spirited person who wanders about the world with the wind and the stars.
Rhythm and Music accompany them wherever they go.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
浪姬舞者是與風和星辰一起漫遊世界的自由靈魂。
節奏和音樂伴隨他們左右。

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
Dancer Kim is the most famous Wanderer who tours the world with the Maestro Guitar Dong as the team <Nollio>.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
舞娘 金是最著名的浪姬舞者，她與吉他手 東組成的樂隊<諾利奧>正在環遊世界。

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
Soy and myself are Aspiring Wanderers, and there will be a performance of <Nollio> in this town soon, so we are eagerly looking forward to see it.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
我和索伊都是見習浪姬舞者，<諾利奧>很快就要在這個城鎮演出了，我們非常期待。

scripts.text:
[Soy]
If you are a true Dancer, you must be struck with her Dance!
Will I ever meet a Maestro like Guitar Song someday, Mimi?
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
如果你是個真正的舞者，一定會被她的舞蹈所震撼！
米米，我將來能遇到像吉他之歌那樣的大師嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
Just hang in there, Soy. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
加油吧，索伊。哈哈。

scripts.text: Where is the performance?
scripts.translation: 演出在哪裡？

scripts.text: End the conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Soy]
Right in front of the Christmas tree!
White snow, beautiful melody, and my captivating dance.
Don't you think it would be a great performance?
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
就在聖誕樹前！
白雪皚皚，旋律優美，還有我迷人的舞蹈。
你覺得這會是一場很棒的演出嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
If you are interested in becoming a Wanderer, just come back to me anytime. Although I'm not perfect, I will try my best to help you.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
如果你想成為浪姬舞者，隨時都可以來找我。雖然我不完美，但我會盡力幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Soy]
The performance will be held in front of the Christmas tree here in Lutie.
I can't wait! Ah~ I'm losing my senses, Mimi.
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
演出將在薑餅城的聖誕樹前舉行。
我等不及了！啊~我要失去理智了，米米。

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
A Wanderer's dancing charm is higher than that of a dancer or gypsy, everyone will lose their souls when they see their performance.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
浪姬舞者的舞蹈魅力比舞娘或冷豔舞姬更高，看到她們表演的人都會為之著迷。

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
I want to become a Wanderer, but I'm still a dancer.
But I think^3131FF it's better to learn Gypsy's unique skills first, and then become a Wanderer^000000. Soy can't wait to become a Wanderer.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
我想成為浪姬舞者，但我現在還是舞娘。
不過我覺得^3131FF最好先學會冷豔舞姬的專屬技能，然後再轉職為浪姬舞者^000000。索伊迫不及待想成為浪姬舞者的樣子。

scripts.text:
[Soy]
<Nollio> is the best!!
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
<諾利奧>是最棒的！！

scripts.text:
[Soy]
I want to become an famous Wanderer too, Mimi.
scripts.translation:
[索伊]
米米，我也想成為著名的浪姬舞者。

scripts.text:
[Mimi]
Not sure if I'm greedy, but I need to learn all Dancer and Gypsy skills before I can become a Wanderer.
scripts.translation:
[米米]
不知道我是不是太貪心了，但在成為浪姬舞者之前，我需要學會所有舞娘和冷豔舞姬的技能。

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Oh, what should I do?
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
哎呀，我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Oh, what should I do?
Why did they do this?
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
哎呀，我該怎麼辦？
他們為什麼要這麼做？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
I am not sure if Guitar Song is in Comodo, you should go there and find him!
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
我不確定吉他之歌是否在克魔島，你應該去那裡找他！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
They came back!!
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
他們回來了！！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Thanks to you, the performance was successful.
You are so competent!
In return, I will prepare the stage for you someday.
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
多虧了你，演出很成功。
你真是能幹！
作為回報，總有一天我會為你準備舞臺的。

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Ahhh, so distracting!
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
啊，太讓人分心了！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Hey, you there!
Please listen to my story.
Actually, I shouldn't tell anyone.
But I'm so overwhelmed that I might go crazy. Ahhhh~~!
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
嘿，你在那裡！
請聽聽我的故事。
其實我不該告訴任何人的。
但我太焦慮了，快要瘋了。啊~~~~！

scripts.text: Sorry, I don't care.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不關心

scripts.text: What's the matter?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？

scripts.text: Why are you telling me this?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼告訴我這些？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
That's a bit harsh don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
這有點太嚴厲了吧，你不覺得嗎？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
The performance is supposed to be soon!
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
演出馬上就要開始了！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Those people don't feel any responsibility..
We're all expecting them and I've promoted them a lot.
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
那些人完全沒有責任感...
大家都在期待他們，我也大力宣傳了。

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
I told you that I'm overwhelmed!
You don't understand me!
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
我告訴過你我很焦慮！
你不懂我！

scripts.text: Is there a problem?
scripts.translation: 出什麼問題了嗎？

scripts.text: Who do you mean?
scripts.translation: 你指的是誰？

scripts.text: It has nothing to do with me.
scripts.translation: 這與我無關

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
How could they do that?
People will throw snowballs!
Maybe they will even throw a big snowman, no!
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
他們怎麼能這樣？
人們會扔雪球的！
說不定還會扔大雪人過來，不！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
People might grab me by the collar!!
Swing swing, dangling dangling!!
This is awful.
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
人們可能會揪住我的衣領！！
甩來甩去，晃來晃去！！
太可怕了。

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Who?!
It's <Nollio>!
You call that a question?
They are the worst people in the world.
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
誰？！
是<諾利奧>！
你這是在問話嗎？
他們是世界上最糟糕的人。

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
What a heartless thing to say!
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
真是沒心沒肺的話！

scripts.text: Are you afraid of people?
scripts.translation: 你怕人嗎？

scripts.text: The performers caused trouble?
scripts.translation: 是表演者惹麻煩了嗎？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Wouldn't you be afraid of all the eyes of people if you were me?
I am in charge of this performance! A lot of people are looking forward to see it and there are many sponsors who are supporting us! I'm so stressed.
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
換作是你，面對那麼多人的目光難道不害怕嗎？
我是這場演出的負責人！很多人都在期待這場演出，還有那麼多贊助商在支援我們！我壓力好大。

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Yes!
<Nollio> has cancelled their performance!
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
是的！
<諾利奧>取消了他們的演出！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
And they didn't give me any reason whatsoever!
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
而且他們連個理由都沒給我！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Besides the money I spent for promoting and setting up the stage..
How can I handle all the angry people?
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
除了我花在宣傳和搭建舞臺上的錢...
我該怎麼應付那些憤怒的人？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Hey, where are you going!
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
嘿，你要去哪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see that you are worried that the performance is going down the drain.
You wanted to make a successful performance to meet the fan's expectations.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我看出來你很擔心演出會搞砸。
你想讓演出成功，以符合粉絲的期待。

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
I really don't know how I should manage this.
Why did they suddenly cancel the performance?
Do you know?
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
我真的不知道該怎麼處理這件事。
他們為什麼突然取消演出？
你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Why is <Nollio> taking this kind of attitude towards me?
Did I make any mistakes? After making a contract with them, I did everything they demanded of me!
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
為什麼<諾利奧>對我採取這種態度？
我有什麼錯嗎？和他們簽約後，我滿足了他們所有的要求！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's because...

[Performance Manager]
What the hell are you talking about?
Are you teasing me because I'm emotionally unstable?
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
你在說什麼鬼話？
因為我不穩定就在嘲笑我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Oh, I'm so worried that I'm having heart palpitations and I'm starting to feel dizzy!
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
哦，我擔心得心跳加速，開始頭暈了！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
Hey! Can you please go out and find the Maestro Guitar Song?
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
嘿！你能不能出去找找吉他之歌大師？

scripts.text: Ah, okay.
scripts.translation: 好的，我明白了

scripts.text: Why should I do that?
scripts.translation: 我為什麼要這麼做？

scripts.text: I won't!
scripts.translation: 我不去！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
You're asking me why!?
Ahh, no.....
It's because you seem like a similar artist.
You also wanted to watch the performance, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
你問我為什麼？！
啊，不……
是因為你看起來也是同行。
你也想去看演出，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
You are so cold-hearted....
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
你真是冷血無情……

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
I would grab them by their collars if I could!
I would tell them Why are you spoiling the performance? but for now, dealing with the angry sponsors is hard enough... Oh, no!
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
要是能抓住他們的衣領就好了！
我要問問他們為什麼要破壞演出？不過現在，光是應付那些憤怒的贊助商就已經夠難了……啊，不！

scripts.text:
[Performance Manager]
I don't know where Guitar Song is, but it is clear that he likes to visit the Comodo Casino!
Hu, Hurry up!! Oh, I really feel dizzy! Guitar Song!!!
scripts.translation:
[演出經理]
我不知道吉他之歌在哪裡，但他肯定喜歡去克魔島賭場！
呼，快一點！！我真的很頭暈！吉他之歌！！！

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
You can dance ~
You can do your work ~
You are the dancing Queen ~
I am the tambourine King ~
scripts.translation:
[鬱鬱寡歡的樂師]
你可以跳舞~
你可以工作~
你是舞動的皇后~
我是鈴鼓之王~

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
Whew...
scripts.translation:
[鬱鬱寡歡的樂師]
呼……

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
You can dance ~
You can do your work ~
You are the dancing Queen ~
I am the tambourine King ~
scripts.translation:
[鬱鬱寡歡的樂師]
你可以跳舞~
你可以工作~
你是舞動的皇后~
我是鈴鼓之王~

scripts.text:
- You found a Maestro -
- singing a weird song. -
scripts.translation:
- 你發現了一位樂師 -
- 正在唱一首奇怪的歌曲。 -

scripts.text: That's a weird song.
scripts.translation: 那是一首奇怪的歌曲。

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 無視它

scripts.text: - What a weird person, I better stay away. -
scripts.translation: - 真是個怪人，我還是離他遠點好。 -

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
What?!
Are you ignoring my immortal masterpiece <Tambourine King>? You are the first person who's ever slapped me in the face.
scripts.translation:
[鬱鬱寡歡的樂師]
什麼？！
你無視我這首不朽的傑作《鈴鼓之王》？你是第一個扇我耳光的人。

scripts.text: I didn't slap you.
scripts.translation: 我沒有扇你耳光。

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
Oh! Lady, looking at your appearance you must be a dancer, right?
scripts.translation:
[鬱鬱寡歡的樂師]
哦！女士，看你的外表，你一定是個舞娘，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
Do you have a Bard or Minstrel traveling together with you?
If you don't, how about making a traveling troupe with me?
scripts.translation:
[鬱鬱寡歡的樂師]
你有詩人或宮廷樂師和你一起旅行嗎？
如果沒有，要不要和我一起組建一個旅行劇團？

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
The name of the team is <Guitar Song's Agony>.
This name expresses the excruciating pain it takes to create art works.
scripts.translation:
[鬱鬱寡歡的樂師]
團名叫《吉他之歌的煎熬》。
這個名字表達了創作藝術作品所經歷的痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
It has an edgy kind of name So I think that it will be a very popular group.
scripts.translation:
[鬱鬱寡歡的樂師]
這個名字很有個性，我覺得它會非常受歡迎。

scripts.text: Are you Guitar Song?
scripts.translation: 你是吉他之歌嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Huh... I'm a bit disappointed that you finally recognize me now.
Yes, I am the handsome Guitar Song in the famous group <Nollio>.
Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
哈……你終於認出我了，我有點失望。
是的，我就是著名團體《諾利奧》中帥氣的吉他之歌。
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
So how about it? Isn't that a tempting offer to you?
I'm a really famous Maestro at the peak of my popularity. People are dying to work with me, but you are indifferent to me lady.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
那麼，怎麼樣？這難道不是一個誘人的提議嗎？
我是處於人氣巔峰的著名樂師，人們都渴望與我合作，但你對我不屑一顧，女士。

scripts.text: Where is Dancer Kim?
scripts.translation: 舞娘金在哪裡？

scripts.text: Why'd you cancel the performance?
scripts.translation: 為什麼取消演出？

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Why are you asking me that question so suddenly?
Come on, let's just talk about a pleasant matter.
Dancer Kim and the performance have nothing to do with me.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
你突然問這個幹什麼？
好了，我們聊點開心的事吧。
舞娘金和演出跟我沒有任何關係。

scripts.text: What do you mean?
scripts.translation: 你這是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Hey, I told you to stop talking about this matter....
I don't want to think about it. It just hurts my feelings.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
嘿，我說過別提這件事了……
我不想回想。這讓我心裡很不好受。

scripts.text: - Guitar Song is adamantly refusing to talk. What should I do to hear the story about <Nollio>? -
scripts.translation: - 吉他之歌堅決拒絕談論此事。我該怎麼做才能聽到關於<Nollio>的故事？ -

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation: 使用搖籃曲

scripts.translation: - 你湊近吉他之歌的耳邊。 -

Wh...what!! What are you doing?!?
You almost damaged my eardrum.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
什...什麼！！你在幹什麼？！
你差點把我的耳膜震破了。

scripts.text:

Hey, cheer up!!!

[Guitar Song]
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:

你在說什麼？

scripts.translation:

這麼多人都滿懷期待地支援著你。

Aaaaahhh!!!!!

What... what are you doing?!! What's wrong with you!
Security!!!
scripts.translation:

你...你在幹什麼？！你瘋了嗎！
保安！！

Please stop this.
scripts.translation:
[黑衣護衛]
請停止這種行為。

scripts.translation: - 在未學習該技能的情況下無法使用。 -

[{0}]
Looks like I will not get answer even if I force him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來即使強迫他，我也得不到答案。

[{0}]
Ah, ah my Guitar Song~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，啊，我的吉他之歌~

scripts.text:

What? I've got goose bumps.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
什麼？我起雞皮疙瘩了。

I've been watching <Nollio> for years.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我關注<諾利奧>已經好幾年了。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
I know that we are that popular! Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
我知道我們很受歡迎！哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've seen other Maestro's performances but there was no one better than Guitar Song.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我看過其他指揮家的表演，但沒有誰比得上吉他之歌。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
He he he! Yes, I know I am super great!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
嘿嘿嘿！是的，我知道我超級棒！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... When I hear Guitar Song's performance for the first time I has a crush on you immediately.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...當我第一次聽到吉他之歌的表演時，我立刻對你一見鍾情了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It felt like hearing mommy's lullaby~ It was so beautiful and moving... You are the best artist of our time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那感覺就像聽到媽媽的搖籃曲~ 太美太動人了...你是我們這個時代最偉大的藝術家。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Ha ha ha. I know that well, but it feels good to hear a compliment from you!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
哈哈哈。我知道，但聽到你的讚美感覺真好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So I was looking forward to seeing your performance in Lutie this time.
But after I heard the performance got cancelled, I felt so sad.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以我一直期待這次在薑餅城看到你的表演。
但聽說表演取消了，我感到非常難過。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now I can't hear Guitar Song's melody~~
I wanted to dance to your music like a beautiful butterfly.
Is there no way for my dream to be true now? Sob sob...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
現在我聽不到吉他之歌的旋律了~~
我想像美麗的蝴蝶一樣隨著你的音樂起舞。
我的夢想現在沒有實現的可能了嗎？嗚嗚嗚...

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Huh huh! No, that is not...
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
呼呼！不，不是這樣的...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am really happy to meet you in person, but I hope to see your performance in the beautiful snowy town, Lutie.. Sob sob...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很高興能親自見到你，但我希望能在美麗的雪城薑餅城看到你的表演。嗚嗚嗚...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why in the world don't you show us the performance, Guitar Song?
Don't you like me? Sob sob..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
吉他之歌，你為什麼不給我們表演呢？
你不喜歡我嗎？嗚嗚嗚..

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
No, it's not that kind of reason!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
不，不是那種原因！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then please tell me, I really love your music... but now I feel so blue...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那請告訴我，我真的喜歡你的音樂...但現在我感到很沮喪...

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Oh, no! You know...
I want to have a performance, too!
But I cannot do it all by myself!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
哦，不！你知道嗎...
我也想舉辦一場表演！
但我一個人做不到！

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
It's all because of Dancer Kim!
One day, she suddenly got mad and told me that she would quit <Nollio>!
I was also tired of here unpredictable feelings, too!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
這都是舞娘 金的錯！
有一天，她突然發火，說要退出<諾利奧>！
我也受夠了她變幻莫測的情緒！

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Pshaw.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
哼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why did she get mad so suddenly?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她為什麼突然發火？

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
I don't know! She must be holding a grudge for something.
That's what she's like.
She suddenly disappeared and sent me a letter telling me that the team would be disbanded.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
我不知道！她一定是因為什麼事在記恨我。
她就是這樣的人。
她突然消失了，還給我寄了一封信，說樂隊要解散了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where is Dancer Kim now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
舞娘 金現在在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Well, the letter was sent from Hugel.
I guess she might be back at her hometown.
That's where I met her for the first time.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
嗯，那封信是從毀葛寄來的。
我想她可能回到了家鄉。
那是我第一次遇見她的地方。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Although she loses her temper easily, her dance is so wonderful....
I don't know what I am doing wrong.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
雖然她很容易發脾氣，但她的舞蹈真的很美妙....
我不知道自己做錯了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
She smiled so happily that she likes the new song so much..
Who can dance to my music so wonderfully as she did?
Now my music and my life is history... (muttering).
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
她笑得很開心，說她非常喜歡這首新歌..
誰能像她那樣，在我的音樂中跳出如此美妙的舞姿呢？
現在我的音樂和我的人生都成了過去...（喃喃自語）。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Dancer Kim is probably addicted to the monster races in Hugel again!
Back in the day when she was addicted to the monster races, who do you think got her out of it?
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
舞娘 金肯定又沉迷於毀葛的魔物賽跑了吧！
當年她沉迷魔物賽跑的時候，是誰把她拉出來的，你知道嗎？

scripts.text: - You tell him what happened in Hugel and ask him to go back to Lutie. -
scripts.translation: - 告訴他薑餅城發生的事，讓他回去找她。 -

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Oh oh~
You are silly Dancer Kim~
Without me, who else can take care of such a lady like you~
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
噢噢~
你這個傻乎乎的舞娘 金~
沒有我，還有誰能照顧你這樣的女士呢~

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
I'll go there right away and scold her.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
我這就過去好好教訓她一頓。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Okay, I will go to the Christmas tree in Lutie where the performance is supposed to be held.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
好的，我會去薑餅城的聖誕樹那裡，那裡應該是舉辦表演的地方。

scripts.text:
[Cheerless Maestro]
Where is my partner...
scripts.translation:
[鬱鬱寡歡的樂師]
我的搭檔在哪裡...

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
(blank...)
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
（沉默...）

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Sob... sob...
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
嗚...嗚...

scripts.text: Why are you crying?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼在哭？

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
I gave up my dream...
*Sob *Sob.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
我放棄了我的夢想...
*嗚 *嗚。

scripts.text: What do you mean?
scripts.translation: 你這是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
I said goodbye to my partner who had been working with me for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
我和那個與我合作了很久的搭檔說了再見。

scripts.text: Why did you say goodbye?
scripts.translation: 你們為什麼分開了？

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
it's because... sob... sob!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
是因為...嗚...嗚！

scripts.text: You can tell me everything.
scripts.translation: 你可以告訴我一切。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
When Wanderers and Maestro's get together, their abilities become stronger.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
當浪姬舞者和樂師在一起時，他們的能力會變得更強。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
So when they travel, they often get together and perform duets.
They have a good time dancing and playing music.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
所以她們在旅行時，經常會聚在一起進行二重奏。
她們一邊跳舞一邊演奏音樂，度過了一段美好的時光。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
A few days ago, with my partner Guitar Song. I showed a beautiful dance to his music to many people as we usually do.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
幾天前，我和我的搭檔吉他之歌，像往常一樣，伴著他的音樂向許多人展示了一段優美的舞蹈。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
I was really proud of being a Wanderer after I drew all of that enthusiastic applause.
Guitar Song also praised me.
I was so happy that day.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
在那片熱烈的掌聲中，我為自己是一名浪姬舞者而感到無比自豪。
吉他之歌也稱讚了我。
那天我真的很開心。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
But...
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
但是...

scripts.text: What happened next?
scripts.translation: 後來發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
The following morning, I woke up and washed my fave and was looking for something to eat in my room..
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
第二天早上，我醒來洗了臉，正在房間裡找吃的...

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Then Guitar Song suddenly opened the door of my room for some reason and said ^3131FFHey! What the hell are.. you doing here?^000000 and then he threw me out of my room!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
然後吉他之歌不知為何突然推開了我房間的門，說^3131FF嘿！你他媽在...在這裡幹什麼？^000000接著就把我趕出了房間！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
We've been together for a long time but how can he do such a thing to me?
At first, I thought he was kidding around with me! But when he kicked me out of my room...
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
我們在一起這麼久了，他怎麼能這樣對我？
起初，我以為他只是在跟我開玩笑！但當他把我踢出房間時...

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Why didn't he recognize my face?
Do you think he doesn't want to see my face without makeup?
Boo hoo hoo!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
他為什麼認不出我的臉？
你覺得他是不想看到我沒化妝的臉嗎？
嗚嗚嗚！

scripts.text: So you disbanded the team?
scripts.translation: 所以你們解散了隊伍？

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Are you also ignoring my wounded self-respect as a woman?
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
你也在無視我作為女性受傷的自尊心嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No! He is really a caring man!
But I don't think you disbanded your precious team just because of that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不！他真的是個體貼的男人！
但我覺得你們解散珍貴的隊伍，肯定不僅僅是因為這個原因。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
You're right.
It's not just because of that.
The real reason why I disbanded the team is...
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
你說得對。
不僅僅是因為這個。
我解散隊伍的真正原因是...

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
After that day, I went to my hometown, Hugel and I just stayed indoors.
It was then when Shide comforted me with sweet cakes.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
那天之後，我回到了家鄉毀葛，一直待在家裡。
那時是希德用美味的蛋糕安慰了我。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Shide's cake is so wonderful!
It is the most famous cake in Hugel with soft sponge cake and fresh fruits and sweet chocolate cream!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
希德的蛋糕太棒了！
那是毀葛最有名的蛋糕，有著鬆軟的海綿蛋糕、新鮮的水果和香甜的巧克力奶油！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
It felt like all the angels of happiness came to comfort me when I tasted that sweet cake.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
當我品嚐那塊甜美的蛋糕時，感覺所有幸福的天使都來安慰我了。

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
So I ate it every morning and every night.
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
所以我每天早上和晚上都吃它。

scripts.text: Oh, you wouldn't...
scripts.translation: 噢，你不會...

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
The angel of happiness took back my sadness and gave me a lot of belly fat!
Boo hoo hoo hoo!!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
幸福的天使帶走了我的悲傷，卻給了我很多腹部脂肪！
嗚嗚嗚嗚！！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Now I can't wear my dancing clothes!
I am not a dancer who dances like a beautiful butterfly anymore!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
現在我連舞蹈服都穿不下了！
我不再是那個像美麗蝴蝶一樣起舞的舞娘了！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
What is worse, it became hard to bend my waist forward!
Boo hoo hoo!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
更糟糕的是，我的腰變得很難向前彎曲了！
嗚嗚嗚嗚！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
The performance day is approaching, but the angel of happiness brought me a big obstacle.
Now I've fallen into despair again!
I can't let Guitar Song and my fans see me like this!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
演出日就要到了，但幸福的天使卻給我帶來了巨大的障礙。
我又陷入了絕望之中！
我不能讓吉他之歌和我的粉絲看到我這副樣子！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
<Nollio> is over! Boo hoo hoo!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
<諾利奧>結束了！嗚嗚嗚嗚！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Not long ago, I was like a beautiful dove, but now I am just a fat chicken.
Sob sob...!
I think the life of Wanderer Dancer Kim is over now.
Boo hoo hoo hoo!
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
不久前，我還像一隻美麗的鴿子，現在卻變成了一隻肥雞。
嗚嗚...！
我覺得浪姬舞者 金的人生已經結束了。
嗚嗚嗚嗚！

scripts.text: Hey, don't give up.
scripts.translation: 嘿，別放棄

scripts.text: I feel sorry for you.
scripts.translation: 我很同情你

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
My life cannot get out of abyss now......
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
我現在的人生無法走出深淵了......

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
But I already told Guitar Song that it's all over.
Even if it's not over, I cannot do anything right now.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
但我已經告訴吉他之歌一切都結束了。
即使還沒結束，我現在也什麼都做不了了。

scripts.text: If you give up, it will be over.
scripts.translation: 如果你放棄，那就真的結束了

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
But in this situation...
Do I really have a way to change it?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
但在這種情況下...
我真的有辦法改變現狀嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Exercise is the best way!
If you work hard, your bossy will be lighter than before!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
運動是最好的方法！
如果你努力鍛鍊，你的腰圍會比以前更細！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
But I get tired and give up easily.
I think I am going to give up.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
但我很容易累，也很容易放棄。
我想我還是會放棄的。

scripts.text: Well, there's no other way.
scripts.translation: 好吧，別無他法

scripts.text: Let's work together.
scripts.translation: 我們一起鍛鍊吧

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
No dreams and no hope...
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
沒有夢想，也沒有希望...

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Will you exercise together with me?
Really?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
你願意和我一起鍛鍊嗎？
真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
I'm sure that I would try harder if I had someone to workout with.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
如果有人在旁邊一起鍛鍊，我相信我會更努力的。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
I feel better now!
I think I'm gaining strength again!
Let's work together!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
我現在感覺好多了！
我覺得我又重新獲得了力量！
我們一起努力吧！

scripts.text: What should we do first?
scripts.translation: 我們首先該做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
I have a good idea!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
我有個好主意！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Meet me at Abyss Lake.
I'll see you there.
Just go one field South and one field West from here in Hugel.
I'll meet you there.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
在深淵湖見。
我會在那等你。
從毀葛這裡往南走一格，再往西走一格。
我們在那裡碰面。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
I'll meet you at Abyss Lake.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
我在深淵湖等你。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Please tell Guitar Song to go to Lutie
I'll go there after I've packed my luggage!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
請告訴吉他之歌去薑餅城。
等我收拾好行李就過去！

scripts.text:
[Vacant Looking Lady]
Where is my partner......
scripts.translation:
[神情恍惚的女子]
我的搭檔在哪裡......

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Exercising together is good but if we compete for it, I think we'll get a better effect!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
一起鍛鍊固然好，但如果我們比賽的話，我覺得效果會更好！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
From now on, let's compete to see who defeats the Yellow Novus first!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
從現在開始，我們來比賽誰先擊敗黃諾博斯吧！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
You need to defeat 50 Yellow Novus!
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
你需要擊敗50只黃諾博斯！
準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Hurry up before I lose interest!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
快點啦，別讓我失去興趣！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Good! Then ready, set~~
Go!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
好！那麼預備~~
開始！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Whew!
Looks like I've lost!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
呼！
看來我輸了！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
This feeling reminds me of the past where I've crossed the borders of many continents.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
這種感覺讓我想起了過去，我曾跨越許多大陸的邊界。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Ah! Look at this!
I'm getting slimmer, can you see it?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
啊！你看這個！
我變苗條了，你看到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
I feel that my body is full of power.
I suddenly want to see my good partner Guitar Song.
I want to start dancing again.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
我感覺身體充滿了力量。
我突然很想見見我的好搭檔吉他之歌。
我想重新開始跳舞了。

scripts.text: How about dancing in Lutie?
scripts.translation: 去薑餅城跳舞怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Ah! Christmas Village! Yes! Yes!
My dream to dance in Lutie will finally come true.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
啊！聖誕村莊！是的！是的！
我在薑餅城跳舞的夢想終於要實現了。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
I want to dance and jump all day to bring people happiness!
So I will go to Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
我想整天跳舞跳躍，給人們帶來快樂！
所以我要去薑餅城。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Ah, do me a favor, please.
Can you bring Guitar Song to Lutie?
Say that his partner is waiting for him.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
啊，請幫我個忙。
你能帶吉他之歌去薑餅城嗎？
告訴他他的搭檔在等他。

scripts.text: No problem!
scripts.translation: 沒問題！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
You're a good person. I'm really happy that I met you.
Thank god for sending such a stubborn person to me!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
你真是個好心人。我很高興能遇到你。
感謝上天派了這樣一個固執的人給我！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Does it look easy to you?
But I'm sure I have a better chance to win.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
這看起來很容易嗎？
但我確信我贏面更大。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Oh, you came back to me.
I'm so tired. I don't give up halfway. It's a good exercise for me. I will have to give up Nollio to another Wanderer, it's all over....
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
你回來了。
我好累。我不會半途而廢，這對我來說是很好的鍛鍊。不過，我不得不把<諾利奧>交給另一位浪姬舞者了，一切都結束了...

scripts.text: - Dancer Kim dropped down by grief and fatigue -
scripts.translation: - 舞娘 金因悲傷和疲憊倒下了 -

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Huh...?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
嗯...？

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Please tell Song, I will be waiting for him at the Christmas tree.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
請告訴吉他之歌，我會在聖誕樹旁等他。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Hunting Novus is the best exercise, I think.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
我覺得打黃諾博斯是最好的鍛鍊。

scripts.text: - You can't continue the quest because the condition for the quest is not appropriate. -
scripts.translation: - 由於任務條件不符合，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: - You can't continue the quest because you have remaining skill points. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您還有剩餘的技能點，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: - You need to empty your inventory if you want to continue the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 如果您想繼續任務，需要清空您的物品欄。 -

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Please get off of that creature you're riding on.
Then talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
請從您騎乘的生物上下來。
然後再來和我說話。

scripts.text: - <Nollio> is performing. -
scripts.translation: - <諾利奧>正在表演。 -

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
One! Two! Three!
Blue fish dancing~
Fan! Fan! Fan! I am your fan~
With a strong mind and strong will, I complete fishing~
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
一！二！三！
藍色魚在跳舞~
風！風！風！我是你的粉絲~
憑藉堅定的意志和決心，我完成了釣魚~

scripts.text:
[Spectators]
AAAAhhhhhhhhh - - !!!
So cool! Nollio is the best!!!
scripts.translation:
[觀眾]
啊啊啊啊啊 - - ！！
太酷了！諾利奧是最棒的！！！

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Hello, ladies and gentlemen!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
大家好，女士們先生們！

scripts.text:
[Spectators]
Hello!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[觀眾]
你好！！！

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
We are the romantic Wanderer team <Nollio> who stroll along the world following love and wind!
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
我們是浪漫的浪姬舞者組合<諾利奧>，我們沿著世界漫步，追隨愛與風！

scripts.text:
[Spectators]
Wowwwww~!
scripts.translation:
[觀眾]
哇哇哇~！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
It's so fascinating that I can dance in a snowy, beautiful village,
I'm so glad that I came here, Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
能在美麗雪景的村莊裡跳舞，真是太迷人了，
我很高興能來到薑餅城。

scripts.text:
[Spectators]
Yayyyy~
scripts.translation:
[觀眾]
耶耶耶~

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
In fact, this wonderfull performance would have been cancelled because of my carelessness.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
事實上，這場精彩的表演本來會因為我的疏忽而取消。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
I unintentionally made her upset.
Let me take this opportunity to say to her that I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
我不小心讓她生氣了。
請讓我藉此機會向她道歉。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
It's okay.
I'm sorry for behaving as I did.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
沒關係。
抱歉我剛才那樣做。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
In fact there is a friend who cheered me up and helped me get through the hardships I faced when I was depressed in my hometown.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
其實有一位朋友在我家鄉陷入低谷時，鼓勵我並幫助我度過了難關。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
You may love my friend's dance more than mine in the future.
She has a great talent.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
未來你可能會更喜歡我朋友的舞蹈。
她非常有天賦。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Introducing!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
隆重介紹！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
This rising Wanderer star, {0}!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
這位冉冉升起的浪姬舞者新星，{0}！

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Ha ha ha, are you surprised?
Don't look so puzzled?
You led me here, you deserve it.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
哈哈，你驚訝嗎？
別一臉困惑的樣子。
是你把我帶到這裡來的，這是你應得的。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
Oh! You are like a beautiful swan!
The goddess must be jealous to see your beauty.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
哦！你就像一隻美麗的天鵝！
女神看到你的美貌一定會嫉妒的。

scripts.text:
[Dancer Kim]
{0}! I hope to see your beautiful exploits in the future.
Also, I hope you to meet your precious Maestro.
Let's perform together later, shall we? Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘 金]
{0}！希望未來能看到你精彩的表演。
也希望你遇到你珍貴的指揮家。
以後我們一起表演吧，好嗎？哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Guitar Song]
Thanks to you, I didn't lose my precious partner.
Thank you a lot.
Soon I will make a song for you, so wait for it.
scripts.translation:
[吉他之歌]
多虧了你，我沒有失去我珍貴的搭檔。
非常感謝。
很快我會為你寫一首歌，敬請期待。
